readiness.primary_reason: Case includes explicit states, target/decoy entities, node regions, hotspot spans, typed objectives, and confidence/clash guardrails; wet-lab construct details can further tighten thresholds.

design_goal.primary: Re-evolve masked H/L CDRs from a Proteo-R1 demo case while preserving framework and focusing the antigen spec-mask hotspot.
design_goal.formal_success_definition: Improve the typed positive-state objectives while suppressing typed negative/decoy objectives, preserving local node confidence, and avoiding severe clashes or unfolding.

positive_signals: Masked CDR node confidence stays above floor.
failure_signals: Interface is broad but not hotspot-centered.

benchmark_start.rationale: The Proteo-R1 ground-truth CDRs are not used as the executable start; masked CDR spans are filled with neutral residues to create recovery room.
benchmark_start.interpretation: The executable binder segments are intentionally degraded relative to the reference/oracle sequence so evolution has measurable room to improve. The reference sequence is metadata only and is not used as the starting template.

information_gaps: Whether the goal is de novo CDR recovery, improvement over ground truth, or robustness to masked inputs.
External negative antigens for selectivity if desired.
